name: narrative-document
title: Narrative document
description: Commentary or a board paper: sections of text written in the Lens and stored in TM1 text cells, with live numbers dropped into the sentences ({{revenue}}). Read, print, or edit if you are an editor.

settings.heading: The document title
settings.subtitle: One line under it
settings.cube: The cube holding the text cells
settings.sections: [{ title, at: { every dimension: member }, placeholder }] — each section's text is one text (string) cell; put the string member's dimension first in at
settings.numbers: { name: { cube, at: { dimension: member }, format } } — live numbers; write {{name}} in the text to show it
settings.editors: [TM1 groups] — who sees Edit (TM1 security still decides what can be saved)
settings.format: Default number format: number, k$ or $
settings.writes: The cubes the text is saved to

sections.title: Summary
sections.placeholder: How did the year go? e.g. Net profit was {{np}} against a target of {{np_target}}.
